name: Spark-Zeppelin-MySQL-Environment
updateContentCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y mysql-server && wget https://apache.org && tar -xzf spark-3.5.1-bin-hadoop3.tgz && sudo mv spark-3.5.1-bin-hadoop3 /opt/spark && wget https://apache.org && tar -xzf zeppelin-0.11.1-bin-all.tgz && sudo mv zeppelin-0.11.1-bin-all /opt/zeppelin && wget https://maven.org && sudo mv mysql-connector-j-8.3.0.jar /opt/spark/jars/
postStartCommand: sudo service mysql start && export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64 && export SPARK_HOME=/opt/spark && /opt/zeppelin/bin/zeppelin-daemon.sh start
